I think she should just say "I finally got the sleeves to fit." That's the whole line. She made that costume for herself weeks ago, so it's really her letting go of the part

That line is the whole scene, Dana. Lena finally says it without saying she's hurt, and the sleeves carry all of it. I'd keep it. How did tonight's 30 minutes feel: enough time, or did the scene want more room?
Good. When you sat down at 8, did the scene come easily, or did you have to push to get started?
